assumptions: Drug nodes include DRUG and BIOLOGICAL interventions. Names are matched after removing case, extra whitespace, trademark symbols and parenthetical or bracketed text (e.g. 'Pembrolizumab (Keytruda®)' = 'pembrolizumab'); brand-only names, code names (MK-3475), doses and formulation words stay separate.
Configured generic intervention names are excluded from drug nodes and edges: best supportive care, placebo, saline, standard of care.
All 5,120 matching trials were analyzed, so counts are exact registry totals.
